# polaris Provider

Terraform provider for Apache Polaris (incubating), an open-source Iceberg REST catalog with multi-tenant RBAC and credential vending.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    polaris = {
      source  = "tranxuantruongworld/polaris"
      version = "~> 1.0.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "polaris" {
  server_url    = "http://localhost:8181"
  client_id     = "polaris_root"
  client_secret = "polaris_secret"
  realm         = "default-realm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID for Polaris authentication. May also be set via the `POLARIS_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret for Polaris authentication. May also be set via the `POLARIS_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.
- `realm` (String) The Polaris multi-tenant realm context (header `Polaris-Realm`). Defaults to `default-realm`. May also be set via the `POLARIS_REALM` environment variable.
- `server_url` (String) The base URL of the Apache Polaris service (e.g. `http://localhost:8181`). May also be set via the `POLARIS_SERVER_URL` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) A static Bearer token for Polaris authentication, bypassing OAuth2 client credentials grant. May also be set via the `POLARIS_TOKEN` environment variable.
